releases.new: Convert matplotlib reference lines such as axhline and axvline into Plotly layout shapes with mpl_to_plotly, including date axes.
releases.breaking: Python 3.8 and 3.9 are no longer supported; plotly now requires Python 3.10 or later, so upgrade your Python environment.

releases.new: Convert matplotlib reference lines like axhline and axvline into Plotly layout shapes when using mpl_to_plotly.
releases.breaking: Python 3.8 and 3.9 are no longer supported; upgrade to Python 3.10 or later before installing this version.

releases.new: Draw a marginal heatmap strip in density_heatmap by setting marginal_x or marginal_y to heatmap.
releases.breaking: hex_to_rgb now raises an error for invalid-length hex codes, and map traces need newer browsers (Safari 15, Chrome 56, Firefox 51); fix inputs or upgrade.

releases.new: Draw vector fields as arrows using the new quiver trace type from the updated plotly.js 4.0.0.
releases.breaking: Removed deprecated figure factory create_* functions, Orca, old Kaleido, and mapbox traces; switch to px or graph_objects equivalents, map traces, and Kaleido 1.0 or later.

releases.new: Add the quiver trace type to visualize vector fields using arrows.
releases.breaking: Removed Figure Factory create_* functions, the engine argument, Orca and old Kaleido, and mapbox traces; switch to Kaleido 1.0+ and map traces.
The modebar button sendDataToCloud was renamed to sendChartToCloud, so update any modebar configuration that references the old name.

releases.new: Set a font for the whole figure directly through a new optional font parameter in make_subplots.
Create maplibre-based maps with the new px functions scatter_map, line_map, choropleth_map, and density_map.
Add subtitles to plots using the new subtitle attribute on the layout title.
Use bold weight, italic style and small-caps variant options for fonts in figures.
Control the stacking order of SVG traces within a cartesian subplot using the new zorder attribute.
